'''''Golden Opportunity''''' was a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] that was operated by the company [[Skydove Freight]]<ref name="Tempest Feud" /> during the era of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]],<ref name="Scourge">[[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']]</ref> and it was flown by the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Pocka]].

==Behind the scenes==
''Golden Opportunity'' was created by [[Jeff Grubb]] and [[Owen K.C. Stephens|Owen K.C. Stevens]], and it featured in the [[2002]] [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|role-playing]] adventure ''Tempest Feud''. In ''Tempest Feud'', it was possible for Pocka to transport the player characters aboard ''Golden Opportunity'' to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], so that they could attend a party in [[Popara's penthouse|the penthouse]] of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Popara Anjiliac Diresto|Popara]], if the players lacked a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] of their own. However, the [[2012]] novel [[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']] established the [[canon]] series of events from the ''Tempest Feud'' storyline and established that the [[Jedi archivist/Legends|Jedi archivist]] [[Mander Zuma]] and the [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] [[Reen Irana]] and [[Eddey Be'ray]]&mdash;who fulfill the role of the ''Tempest Feud'' player characters&mdash;traveled to Nar Shaddaa on the freighter ''[[New Ambition]]'', thus rendering Pocka's transportation of the player characters aboard ''Golden Opportunity'' non-canon.
